# Marshall Elliott

[Grit](../codex/factions.md#grit)

## Overview

- **Age:** about fifty  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott maintains an unshaven face and long hair. He pledged to refrain from cutting his hair or shaving until the [Grits](../codex/factions.md#grit) achieved power.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read individual who possesses a somewhat tempersome yet very determined nature. He is skilled in storytelling, rivalling even Captain Jim, and can sing old Scotch ballads in a fine tenor voice.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## History

Marshall Elliott was a noted dancer in his youth who vowed to never shave his face or cut his hair until the Liberals won political power. Over the years, he frequented the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, where he celebrated New Year's Eve with Captain Jim, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), dancing around the fire with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). Following a general election that resulted in a [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory, Marshall finally shaved his long-kept beard and cut his hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marshall-elliott--uncle-jim.md)

Marshall Elliott and Captain Jim are longtime friends and fishing companions. They share social gatherings together, such as celebrating New Year's Eve at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse and dancing around the fire. Captain Jim also keeps friends like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) updated on Marshall's life, including when Marshall finally shaves his beard following a political victory.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), +6 more_
